command.name: Veilflame
verbatim: Rounds 2,5,8: Deal Fire Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +75%). Additionally, grant yourself Evade (Rate: 10%) for 1 round(s). If Veilflame dealt Fire Damage to an enemy Champion, double your chances to Evade. Evade causes each instance of damage against the target to have a chance to be ignored.
At 10 Stars: Rounds: 3,6,9: Deal Fire Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +30%). Deal triple the damage to enemy Champion dragons.

vanguard.name: Hunter's Wrath
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Ashen Phantom
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round: Reduce the Tactical and Fire Damage dealt of all enemies afflicted with Weakened by -18%, until the end of the round. If the enemy is a Champion, double this effect.

habits.name: Ember Snare
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 60% chance to reduce the Initiative and Intelligence by -40% (enhanced by Instinct) and afflict Burn (Damage Rate: +20%) on 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank). Each effect lasts for 2 round(s). Burn deals Fire Damage to the target each round.

habits.name: Unraveled
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round: For each enemy that is Weakened, reduce the Intelligence, Instinct, and Initiative by -14% (enhanced by Intelligence) of 3 Enemies in any lane until the end of the round. If the Weakened enemy is a Champion, increase this effect.

habits.name: Backdraft
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Fire Damage Received by +20% of 1 Enemy in the same lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Champion's Scourge
habits.verbatim: Veilflame gains: Rounds: 3,6,9: Deal Fire Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +30%). Deal triple the damage to enemy Champion dragons.

formation_needs: Right Flank ally benefiting from Strength and Initiative
